xml_snippets.Title: Freeholder (RoyalTitleDef)
xml_snippets.Label: freeholder
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The Imperial title of freeholder is used by the Empire to signifies a fully-respected individual. Most Imperial citizens earn it while young through volunteer work or military service. The title is also offered to outsiders who act with honor in the eyes of the Empire.
xml_snippets.XML:
<RoyalTitleDef ParentName="BaseEmpireTitle">

    <defName>Freeholder</defName>

    <label>freeholder</label>

    <description>The Imperial title of freeholder is used by the Empire to signifies a fully-respected individual. Most Imperial citizens earn it while young through volunteer work or military service. The title is also offered to outsiders who act with honor in the eyes of the Empire.</description>

    <seniority>0</seniority>

    <favorCost>1</favorCost>

    <changeHeirQuestPoints>1000</changeHeirQuestPoints>

    <allowDignifiedMeditationFocus>False</allowDignifiedMeditationFocus>

    <awardWorkerClass>RoyalTitleAwardWorker_Instant</awardWorkerClass>

  </RoyalTitleDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Yeoman (RoyalTitleDef)
xml_snippets.Label: novice
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The Imperial title of novice is held by those who have recently been initiated into the ranks of the psychic cult. It gives the holder the right to use low-level psychic abilities as part of their learning.\n\nThis title is often held by senior soldiers, warskiff pilots, spies, advisors, diplomats, intrusion operatives, and other key individuals. Many important people spend their entire lives as novices.
xml_snippets.XML:
<RoyalTitleDef ParentName="BaseEmpireTitle">

    <defName>Yeoman</defName>

    <label>novice</label>

    <description>The Imperial title of novice is held by those who have recently been initiated into the ranks of the psychic cult. It gives the holder the right to use low-level psychic abilities as part of their learning.\n\nThis title is often held by senior soldiers, warskiff pilots, spies, advisors, diplomats, intrusion operatives, and other key individuals. Many important people spend their entire lives as novices.</description>

    <seniority>100</seniority>

    <favorCost>6</favorCost>

    <changeHeirQuestPoints>1000</changeHeirQuestPoints>

    <commonality>1</commonality>

    <maxPsylinkLevel>1</maxPsylinkLevel>

  </RoyalTitleDef>

xml_snippets.Title: Acolyte (RoyalTitleDef)
xml_snippets.Label: acolyte
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The title of acolyte is the title of senior learners in the psychic cult, and encompasses a wide range of practical positions. Some acolytes are purely students, learning to lead troops, manage societies, or use psycasts in specialized schools. Others come from wealthy families and might own city buildings or farm complexes.\n\nDuring wartime, an acolyte might lead a platoon of troops, captain a small frigate, or serve their liege as an advisor.

Acolyte The title of acolyte is the title of senior learners in the psychic cult, and encompasses a wide range of practical positions. Some acolytes are purely students, learning to lead troops, manage societies, or use psycasts in specialized schools. xml_snippets.Label: knight
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The title of knight is held by agents of the psychic cult who have fully passed their training, but who have not ascended to higher leadership roles. xml_snippets.Title: Praetor (RoyalTitleDef)
xml_snippets.Label: praetor
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The title of praetor denotes a member of the psychic cult who carries out field missions in a more senior role than a mere knight. Praetors often act alone, but may also command knights and lower members.\n\nDuring peacetime, a praetor will usually manage a city district, asteroid sector, or agricultural region. During war, they take authority over the smallest independent combat units - terrestrial troop cohorts, or space-borne destroyers or combat groups.

xml_snippets.Title: Baron (RoyalTitleDef)
xml_snippets.Label: baron
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The title of baron is the lowest of the psychic lords who can act as a semi-independent ruler. Most barons are subordinate to a higher lord. The baron is obliged to provide both personal service as a warrior or advisor, and economic support like money and troops.\n\nIn the Empire, a baron will typically own a city sector, mining colony, or similar outfit. At wartime, a baron may captain a capital ship in name, or control a regiment of soldiers.

xml_snippets.Label: stellarch
xml_snippets.Description Originale: The Imperial title of stellarch represents dominion over an entire star system.\n\nIn the Empire, since interstellar travel times are years long, stellarchs rule their systems with a great degree of independence.
